work_unit: Record and package a real LicenceIQ assessment walkthrough

dispatch.scope: Read-only selector, flow, timing, and acceptance-plan review for a live Playwright recording.

coordinator_work: Created a repeatable Playwright recorder that uses the local app and the fictional bundled licence sample.
Created an MP4 conversion utility that does not alter recorded application actions.
Corrected one strict Playwright locator after the first run found three separate 'Unsaved changes' labels.

passed: Python syntax checks passed for the recorder and MP4 converter.
Playwright smoke recording passed against http://127.0.0.1:3000 before the live run.
The complete live run passed and produced a 319-second browser capture after guest access, account registration, login, upload, live reading, evidence, review save, three Q&A paths, and logout.
The final MP4 opens successfully in OpenCV at 1600x900, 25 FPS, 7,826 frames, and 313.0 seconds.
First, middle, and final MP4 frames all decode successfully.
validation.first_attempt: Stopped at the review status assertion because a broad text locator matched three elements; corrected by scoping the assertion to the extracted-information form save status.

limitations: The recording uses only fictional sample data and a fresh local demonstration account.
It is a silent live product walkthrough; the separate demo script can be used as the spoken narration when presenting it.
